## Description {#details}

Main C++ header file with the declarations for the µOS++ lists classes.

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-h">lists.h</Link></code> header file contains the C++ declarations of the <b>µOS++ Intrusive Lists</b> classes, delivering an efficient and lightweight linked list management system tailored for embedded applications.

The classes implementations are in the <Link to="/docs/api/files/src/lists-cpp">lists.cpp</Link> and <Link to="/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-inlines-h">lists-inlines.h</Link> files.
